About.metaDescription: The booking platform built for the Gulf's appointment-based businesses — bilingual, deposit-backed, no app to install.
About.title: Built for how the Gulf books
About.p1: Across the Gulf, consultants, teachers, coaches, and specialists run on appointments — and most of them run on chat. Bookings live in scattered WhatsApp threads, two clients land in the same slot, and no-shows quietly drain the day. The tool that once worked becomes the bottleneck as the practice grows.
About.p2: The software that exists was mostly built for other markets. It treats Arabic as an afterthought, ignores right-to-left layouts, or forces every customer to download yet another app — none of which fits how business actually works here: bilingual, relationship-driven, and built on trust.
About.p3: Mawedly is the answer to that gap: a booking platform that speaks Arabic and English natively, protects every session with a simple deposit, and keeps the direct WhatsApp connection clients already rely on. It's for the consultant, the teacher, the specialist, and every appointment-based expert who deserves better than a cluttered chat thread.
About.missionBody: To give every service business in the Gulf a booking experience that feels effortless — in their language, on their terms.

Faq.metaDescription: Answers about how booking, deposits, languages, and data work on Mawedly.
Faq.title: Frequently asked questions
Faq.subtitle: Everything you might want to know before you start.
Faq.q1: Does the customer need to create an account?
Faq.a1: No. Customers book directly from your link — they just pick a time, enter their name and phone number, and upload their transfer receipt. There's no app to install and no sign-up.
Faq.q2: How does the customer pay the deposit?
Faq.a2: The booking deposit is a manual bank transfer. The customer transfers the deposit straight to your bank account and uploads the receipt; you review it and confirm the booking. There's no payment gateway or card processing at the booking step — the deposit reaches you directly with no middleman.
Faq.a3: Yes. Each business only sees its own data, protected by row-level security. Bank QR codes and uploaded receipts are stored privately and are only accessible through secure, time-limited links.
Faq.a4: Completely. Mawedly is bilingual from the ground up — Arabic with full right-to-left layout and English left-to-right. Your customers choose their language, and you run your dashboard in yours.
Faq.q5: How does the customer get confirmation?
Faq.a5: After booking, the customer sees their appointment is pending. Once you review the deposit and confirm, they're notified — and an email confirmation can be sent automatically if they provided an email address.
Faq.q6: Can I use my own WhatsApp?
Faq.a6: Yes. Every booking includes a direct WhatsApp link to your number, so you can keep talking to customers exactly as you do today — Mawedly just removes the scheduling chaos.
Faq.q7: What kinds of businesses is it for?
Faq.a7: Any expert whose work runs on appointments: private tutors and coaches, business consultants, nutrition and mental-health specialists, lawyers, and consulting centres. If you book people into time slots, Mawedly fits.
Faq.q8: Do I need any technical skills to set it up?
Faq.a8: Not at all. Sign up with your email, add your services and working hours, and share your booking link. Most experts are live the same day.
Faq.q9: And how do I pay for the plan itself?
Faq.a9: Your monthly plan subscription (beyond the free tier) is handled securely by card through Lemon Squeezy, and you can cancel anytime. Note the distinction: the plan subscription is between you, the merchant, and Mawedly — while your customers' payments stay directly between you and the customer. Mawedly never touches your money.
Faq.a10: No. Mawedly is a scheduling tool only. You add your own payment instructions (account number, QR code, or any method) and the customer pays you directly — we never touch your money.
Faq.q11: Do I need a professional license to use Mawedly?
Faq.a11: Mawedly is a general tool for anyone. If your profession requires a license, you are responsible for ensuring your license is valid. Mawedly does not verify licenses.
Faq.q12: Where is my data stored and how do I delete it?
Faq.a12: Data is stored on secure servers via Supabase (see the Privacy Policy). You can delete your account and all your data anytime from the dashboard, or by emailing us at hello@mawedly.com.
Faq.q13: Is Mawedly responsible for service quality?
Faq.a13: No. Mawedly is a technical tool only, and the relationship between you and the customer is direct. Mawedly does not guarantee service quality or verify practitioners' qualifications.

Privacy.metaDescription: What data Mawedly collects, how it's used, and the third parties involved.
Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: Mawedly is a general online scheduling tool for creating booking links and managing appointments. This policy explains what we collect, why, and how we protect it. Mawedly complies with the Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) of Saudi Arabia.
Privacy.collectBody: For service providers: name, email, phone number, business details, working hours, and optional payment info (account number/QR code). For customers booking: name, phone number, and optionally email. Customers may also upload a transfer receipt as proof of payment (optional), stored privately.
Privacy.useBody: We use your data solely to operate the scheduling service: creating and managing appointments, preventing conflicts, and sending booking notifications and reminders by email or WhatsApp. Analytics data (peak hours, appointment counts) is private to your account and is never shared with any third party. We do not handle your money — payment happens directly between you and the customer. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.
Privacy.thirdBody: We use Supabase for our database and secure cloud storage, Resend to deliver email notifications, WhatsApp (WhatsApp/Meta) to send booking notifications and reminders, and Lemon Squeezy to process your paid plan subscription (if you subscribe). Your customers' booking payments happen directly between you and the customer with no payment gateway. These providers process data only to deliver their service to us.
Privacy.storageBody: Data is stored on Supabase Cloud servers and may be transferred across borders for operational purposes. We apply appropriate safeguards (encryption in transit and data-processing agreements with our providers) to keep your data secure.
Privacy.securityBody: Encryption in transit (TLS/SSL). Full tenant isolation via row-level security (RLS): each provider accesses only their own data and never sees another provider's customers. QR codes, receipts, and license scans are kept in private storage and served only through secure, time-limited links.
Privacy.contactsBody: Your contacts (your customers) are stored in your account only — we do not access or sell them. When you delete your account, all contacts are permanently deleted within 30 days.
Privacy.rightsBody: You may access a copy of your data, correct it from the dashboard, delete it anytime via the dashboard or by emailing hello@mawedly.com, and unsubscribe from notifications whenever you wish.
Privacy.retentionBody: We retain your data while you use the service. After account deletion we permanently delete your personal data within 30 days, and transfer receipts within 90 days, keeping only an anonymous statistical record.
Privacy.cookiesBody: We use only essential cookies needed to run the site (such as your login session). We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.
Privacy.practitionerBody: For professions that require a license, a provider may enter their license number and issuing authority and upload a scan of it. License scans are kept in private storage and never shown publicly. This information is self-entered by the provider, and Mawedly does not verify the validity of any license — confirming the validity of a license and qualifications remains the customer's responsibility before booking.
Privacy.contactBody: For any privacy question or request, email us at hello@mawedly.com.

AcceptableUse.metaDescription: The rules for using Mawedly safely and lawfully, and prohibited practices.
AcceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use Policy
AcceptableUse.intro: This policy ensures Mawedly is used safely and lawfully, protecting the interests of all users and the security of the platform.
AcceptableUse.purposeBody: Mawedly is a tool for scheduling appointments and managing time. Use it for that original purpose, respecting your local laws and your customers' privacy.
AcceptableUse.doBody: Use Mawedly to schedule appointments and manage your time; keep your data accurate and up to date; respect your customers' privacy and don't share their data without permission; and comply with your local laws.
AcceptableUse.securityBody: You may not: attempt to hack or probe our systems for vulnerabilities; use bots or automated software to send excessive requests; attempt to access other users' data; or reverse-engineer or decompile the app.
AcceptableUse.contentBody: You may not post unlawful, fraudulent, or misleading content; racist, inciting, or abusive content; pornographic content (any child exploitation will be reported to the authorities immediately); or harassment or threats of violence.
AcceptableUse.sensitiveBody: Regulated professionals (such as doctors and lawyers) are welcome to schedule their appointments, but you may not enter or store the sensitive data itself inside the tool: clinical health data (such as medical records or diagnoses), confidential legal data (such as court evidence), or sensitive financial data (such as credit card numbers). Use Mawedly for appointments only, and keep sensitive records in a specialized system.
AcceptableUse.spamBody: You may not send spam or unsolicited promotional messages, or use customer data for marketing outside the platform without their permission.
AcceptableUse.commercialBody: You may not resell or rent your account, use the platform to build a competing product, or impersonate or pretend to be a Mawedly employee.
AcceptableUse.consequencesBody: We may suspend or terminate your account immediately and without prior notice if you violate this policy, and we may report the matter to the authorities if the violation is criminal.

Dpa.metaDescription: How Mawedly processes data on your behalf as a data processor, and each party's obligations.
Dpa.title: Data Processing Addendum
Dpa.intro: This addendum explains how Mawedly processes data on your behalf and each party's obligations.
Dpa.partiesBody: You (the user) are the data Controller. Mawedly is the data Processor, processing data on your behalf and per your instructions.
Dpa.natureBody: Mawedly is a technical scheduling tool. You control: what data you enter (your customers' names and appointments), its purpose (scheduling), and who accesses it. We process this data only to provide the scheduling service — nothing more.
Dpa.mawedlyBody: We process data only per your instructions; we do not sell it or use it for advertising; we notify you promptly if we discover a security breach affecting your data; we help you fulfil data-subject rights (access/correction/deletion); and we delete your data within 30 days of account deletion.
Dpa.yourBody: You are responsible for the accuracy and lawfulness of the data you enter, obtaining your customers' consent before collecting their data, and complying with data-protection laws in your country (PDPL, GDPR, CCPA, etc.). If your profession requires a license, you are responsible for its validity.
Dpa.subprocessorsBody: We use the following sub-processors. We may update the list and will notify you of material changes.
Dpa.transferBody: Data is stored on Supabase Cloud servers and may be transferred across borders for operational purposes, with appropriate safeguards (encryption and data-processing agreements).
Dpa.securityBody: Encryption in transit (TLS/SSL), tenant isolation via row-level security (RLS), and secure, time-limited file links.
Dpa.contactBody: For data requests or breach reports: hello@mawedly.com.

salons.metaTitle: Booking system for salons and beauty studios — Mawedly
salons.metaDescription: A salon booking link that shows only genuinely open chair time and blocks double bookings. Arabic and English, no app, and you set your own payment terms.
salons.h1: Booking software for salons and beauty studios
salons.lead: A salon sells time that cannot be stored. A chair that sat empty from two until four is not sold later — those two hours are simply gone. Mawedly gives you one booking link that shows what is actually free, so the customer books herself and you get notified straight away.
salons.answer: Mawedly is a booking link for salons: it shows open chair time in real time, prevents double bookings automatically, and works in Arabic and English. It does not touch your money — you publish your own payment instructions and the customer pays you directly.

problems.t: A long service in the wrong slot
problems.b: A colour treatment needing three hours booked two hours before closing. You find the clash standing in front of the client, not before she arrives.
Two staff answering WhatsApp at once produce two identical appointments. Apologising to one of them costs more than the booking was worth.
"When are you free?" "Tuesday?" "No, Wednesday" — ten messages to place thirty minutes, multiplied by every client you have.

solutions.b: Each service carries its real length, so a slot too short to hold it never appears. The colour treatment only shows where it finishes before closing.
The moment a slot is taken it vanishes for everyone. Nothing depends on two staff members remembering to tell each other.

solutions.t: A QR code on the front desk
solutions.b: The client on her way out books her next visit before she leaves — the highest-intent moment of her whole day.

faq.q: Does the customer need to install anything?
faq.a: No. The link opens straight in a browser. That is deliberate: any required download loses you a share of bookings at the install step.

faq.q: Can I ask for a deposit on long services?
faq.a: You can ask, but the transfer happens directly between you and the client. You publish your payment details and she uploads the receipt — Mawedly never handles the money.

faq.q: I have several stylists. How does that work?
faq.a: Each one is added as a provider with her own hours, and the client picks who she wants. The free Starter plan covers one provider; Center covers up to five.

tutors.metaTitle: Booking link for tutors and private teachers — Mawedly
tutors.metaDescription: A booking link for private lessons that shows real availability and stops clashes. Arabic and English, with built-in video calls on paid plans.
tutors.h1: A booking link for tutors and private teachers
tutors.lead: Teaching by the hour ties your income to a calendar. The lesson cancelled last night will not sell this morning, and the lesson postponed three times ends the study plan before it starts. Mawedly turns your schedule into a single link.
tutors.answer: Mawedly is a booking link for private tutors and trainers: the student or parent picks a genuinely open slot and the lesson arrives confirmed, in Arabic or English, with no messages exchanged.

problems.b: "Let's push it to next week" repeats until the syllabus is behind and the income stops being predictable.
One student on WhatsApp, another on Instagram, a third agreed verbally. The real timetable exists only in your head.
A student in Riyadh and a parent in London agree on "seven" and mean two different hours.

solutions.t: A confirmed lesson, not a verbal promise
solutions.b: Booking holds the slot in your calendar immediately — commitment starts at the booking, not at the lesson.

solutions.t: One link instead of three apps
solutions.b: Put it in your Instagram bio or a single WhatsApp message, and every student books from the same place.

solutions.t: The video call comes with the slot
solutions.b: Virtual lessons get a call link attached to the booking, with no third tool to explain to a parent (Professional plan and above).

faq.q: Does it work for group classes?
faq.a: Booking in Mawedly is one-to-one: each slot belongs to a single student. A fixed group is closer to a recurring timetable than to a booking link.

faq.q: How do I block school hours?
faq.a: You set your working hours once in settings and nothing outside them is ever offered. What is not shown cannot be booked.

faq.q: Does it remind students before a lesson?
faq.a: Yes — automated email reminders are available from the Professional plan. The free plan shows bookings in your dashboard without sending anything automatically.

consultants.metaTitle: Booking page for consultants and freelancers — Mawedly
consultants.metaDescription: A professional booking page for independent consultants: the client picks a genuinely open slot and the session arrives confirmed. Arabic and English, no app.
consultants.h1: A booking page for consultants and freelancers
consultants.lead: An independent consultant sells time and reputation together. A calendar run over chat reads as less professional than the work deserves — and the free discovery call is the single most forgotten appointment in the business.
consultants.answer: Mawedly is a booking page for consultants and freelancers: one link showing your sessions, their prices and your open times, with an instant notification for every booking — in Arabic and English.

problems.b: What costs nothing gets treated as costing nothing. The discovery call carries the highest no-show rate in consulting work.

problems.t: A first impression made over chat
problems.b: A corporate client asks for a meeting and receives "send me your availability". Professionalism is judged at the first interaction.
You restate the length and price of every session in every conversation, instead of the client reading it and deciding.

solutions.t: Service, price and duration on the page
solutions.b: The client sees what they get, how long it takes and what it costs before booking — the negotiation over basics disappears.
Ask for a holding amount and review the receipt before confirming. Payment happens directly between you and the client; Mawedly is a scheduling tool only.

solutions.t: A page you can share as-is
solutions.b: One link in your LinkedIn profile or email signature replaces the back-and-forth entirely — in whichever language your client reads.

faq.q: Can I hide prices on the booking page?
faq.a: Prices show with the service, because transparency filters out unserious bookings. For scope-priced work, define a short fixed-price discovery session instead.

faq.q: Does it sync with Google Calendar?
faq.a: Mawedly provides an add-to-calendar button and .ics attachments in emails from the Professional plan. There is no two-way sync with your calendar.

faq.q: I work with international clients — does it fit?
faq.a: The page is bilingual, but WhatsApp numbers are supported for the six Gulf countries only. A client outside them books and receives email normally.

coaches.metaTitle: Booking system for fitness coaches and nutritionists — Mawedly
coaches.metaDescription: A booking link for training and nutrition sessions: real availability, instant confirmation, Arabic and English. A scheduling tool only — it never handles your money.
coaches.h1: Booking software for coaches and nutritionists
coaches.lead: Coaching runs on continuity. A session that falls out of the week is not made up by two sessions the following week — what breaks is the plan itself, not just the appointment.
coaches.answer: Mawedly is a booking link for fitness coaches, life coaches and non-clinical nutritionists: the client books a genuinely open slot and you are notified instantly, in Arabic or English.

problems.b: A client commits for three weeks and vanishes in the fourth. The gap costs them the result and costs you the renewal.
Six in the evening is the only slot anyone asks for. With no visible calendar, time goes to whoever asked first rather than to what is open.
One client at the gym and another on video at the same hour, with nothing anywhere marking the difference.

solutions.t: The next session is booked now
solutions.b: After each session, one link locks in the next — continuity is built by booking, not by reminding.
The analytics dashboard maps which hours actually fill, so you extend the ones in demand rather than guessing (Center plan).
You set the type per session, and virtual ones get a call link automatically from the Professional plan.

faq.q: Is Mawedly suitable for medical clinics?
faq.a: No. Mawedly is a general scheduling tool and is not built to handle clinical health data. It fits coaching, fitness and general non-clinical nutrition.
Mawedly schedules appointments; it does not manage subscriptions. You agree the package with your client outside the platform, and they book their sessions through your link.

faq.q: Is there a limit on sessions?
faq.a: Each plan has a monthly ceiling — 15 on free, 60 on Professional, 120 on Center, unlimited on Enterprise.

professional-services.metaTitle: Appointment booking for lawyers, accountants and professional firms — Mawedly
professional-services.metaDescription: A booking page for professional consultations: real availability, instant confirmation, Arabic and English. A scheduling tool only — payment stays between you and your client.
professional-services.lead: Professional advice is sold by the hour and judged on trust. An appointment arranged over scattered messages reads as less disciplined than the work itself, and one that collides with a hearing or a review costs more than it was worth.
professional-services.answer: Mawedly is a booking page for lawyers, accountants and independent engineers: the client books a consultation in a genuinely open slot and it arrives confirmed, in Arabic or English. Mawedly does not verify professional licences.

problems.t: The appointment that hits the hearing
problems.b: A hearing runs two hours over and three appointments behind it collapse. With no single calendar, the day gets rebuilt by phone.
Every booking passes through a third person who asks, replies and coordinates — operating cost on a simple appointment.
A ten-minute question takes the same space as a full contract review, because nothing distinguishes them in advance.

solutions.t: Each consultation with its own length and fee
solutions.b: A thirty-minute query and a two-hour review are two different service types booking two different amounts of space.
The client sees what is open and books it; the firm receives a finished appointment instead of a coordination thread.
Your licence number and issuing body appear on your page — verifying them is the client's responsibility, and Mawedly says so plainly.

faq.q: Does Mawedly verify my professional licence?
faq.a: No. Mawedly is a technical scheduling tool: it does not verify credentials or guarantee service quality. The badge displays what you entered, and checking it is the client's responsibility.
Data is used to run scheduling only. It is not shared with third parties and not sold. The privacy policy and data processing addendum set out the PDPL commitments in full.

faq.q: Can several lawyers in one firm use it?
faq.a: Yes. Each is added as a provider with their own hours. The Center plan supports up to five, Enterprise has no limit.

calendly.metaTitle: Calendly alternative for Arabic-speaking businesses — Mawedly vs Calendly
calendly.metaDescription: An honest comparison of Mawedly and Calendly: Arabic and RTL, flat SAR pricing versus per-seat USD, and the cases where Calendly is the better choice.
calendly.lead: Calendly is a strong scheduling product and is broader than Mawedly in plenty of ways. This page sets out where the two actually differ, and where Calendly — not Mawedly — is the right call.
calendly.answer: The core difference: Calendly is built for teams scheduling meetings, in English, priced per seat in USD. Mawedly is built for Gulf businesses selling appointments, with a full right-to-left Arabic interface and flat SAR pricing. Calendly collects payments through Stripe and PayPal; Mawedly never handles money at all.
calendly.asOf: The figures below were taken from Calendly's own pages on 6 August 2026. Prices change — check theirs before deciding anything.

diffs.b: Mawedly is Arabic and English from the ground up, with a full RTL layout. Calendly offers its site in five languages — English, French, Spanish, German and Portuguese — and Arabic is not among them. On Calendly's own community forum (22 October 2025), a Community Manager answered a request for Arabic and RTL support by saying he had "no timeline or a roadmap" for it. If most of your customers read Arabic, this is not cosmetic: half of the booking page reaches them in another language.

diffs.t: Pricing: flat SAR versus per-seat USD
diffs.b: Calendly prices per seat: $10/month for Standard and $16 for Teams on annual billing, with Enterprise starting at $15,000 a year. Mawedly prices per business, not per seat: 99 SAR a month covers up to five providers. A salon with four stylists pays for four seats on Calendly.

Calendly's free plan allows one event type and one connected calendar. Mawedly's free plan allows 15 appointments a month and one provider — but an unlimited number of services. That matters if you sell more than one thing: a cut, a colour, a treatment.

Calendly connects Stripe and PayPal to collect payment inside the booking flow, from the Standard plan up. Mawedly does not, and will not: you publish your own payment instructions and the customer pays you directly. That is a real constraint, not a feature — see below.

Mawedly builds a wa.me link into every booking, because WhatsApp is the channel customers in the Gulf actually use. Numbers are supported for six countries: Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Bahrain, Qatar, Kuwait and Oman.
Calendly wins this outright: Salesforce, HubSpot and Marketo, round-robin distribution, SSO, SAML and SCIM, an API with webhooks, mobile apps and browser extensions. Mawedly has none of it.

calendly.wrongTitle: When Mawedly is the wrong choice
calendly.wrongLead: These are not polite hedges. If one of them describes you, Calendly or something like it fits better, and we would rather say so than waste your time.
wrong: You want to take payment inside the booking page. Mawedly never handles money — payment happens directly between you and your customer, and verifying the transfer is on you.
You need Salesforce or HubSpot, or round-robin distribution across a sales team. None of that exists in Mawedly.
You need two-way sync with Google Calendar or Outlook. Mawedly offers an add-to-calendar button and .ics files only, which is one direction.
You need SSO, SAML or an enterprise security review. Mawedly is a small tool for small businesses.
Most of your customers read English and do not use WhatsApp. In that case Mawedly's two strongest features are irrelevant to you.
calendly.fitTitle: When Mawedly is the better fit
fit: Most of your customers read Arabic, and you want a booking page that looks designed for them rather than translated for them.
You sell services with different durations and prices — not meetings of one fixed length.
You have more than one provider and prefer a flat price to a per-seat one.
WhatsApp is where your customers actually reach you.
You want to set your own payment terms instead of routing through a gateway.

calendly.ctaTitle: Try it before comparing on paper

noShow.metaTitle: No-show cost calculator for appointment businesses — Mawedly
noShow.metaDescription: Work out what missed appointments cost you per month and per year, using your own numbers. Free, no sign-up, in Arabic and English.
noShow.lead: Put in your own figures. We use no industry averages and no borrowed statistics — the only number worth anything here is yours.
noShow.answer: Monthly no-show cost = appointments per month × no-show rate × average appointment price. This calculator applies that to your figures and adds the hours lost.
noShow.rateHint: Don't know your rate? Count last month's appointments and divide the no-shows by the total. Guessing here invalidates everything below it.
noShow.methodBody: Missed = monthly appointments × rate. Monthly loss = missed × average price. Yearly = monthly × 12. Hours = missed × length ÷ 60. No hidden coefficients, no extra assumptions.
noShow.honestTitle: What this calculator does not tell you
noShow.honestBody: Mawedly does not eliminate no-shows, and we do not know how far it would cut yours — anyone quoting you a figure for that is guessing. What it does is prevent clashes, show only genuinely open times, and let you ask for a holding amount before confirming. The commitment comes from the condition you set, not from the tool.
noShow.ctaBody: If the number came out higher than you expected, start with the smallest change: a booking link that shows real availability and lets you ask for a hold.

Demo.h1: Try the booking page your customer sees
Demo.lead: This demo runs entirely in your browser. It creates no account, books nothing real and sends nothing anywhere — click around as much as you like.
Demo.answer: The demo mirrors a Mawedly booking page across its three steps: choose a service, choose an open time, then enter your details. It requires no sign-up and stores nothing.

Demo.successBody: On the real page the provider is notified instantly, and the customer sees a WhatsApp button plus whatever payment instructions the provider published.
